capabilities: Connect any OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic LLM API
Summarize, translate, polish, and explain selected text
Continue writing from the text before the cursor
Show ghost-text completions after a configurable cursor delay
Run custom prompts and free-form Ask AI dialogs
extras: Bilingual (Chinese/English) README, settings, and commands; includes a Test connection button and an AI: Diagnose ghost completion command that writes ghost-diag.txt for troubleshooting.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to call your own LLM endpoint for in-note writing, summarizing, translating, and polishing.

relations.evidence: Built-in presets: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, xAI Grok, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, Zhipu GLM, local Ollama
Works with OpenAI-compatible APIs as well as Anthropic Claude's native Messages API.
For local Ollama, any placeholder value works as the API key

summary: Bring-your-own-model plugin that connects any OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic API to generate continuations, summaries, translations, and polished text in notes.
